lessons.name: Hello, Nice to Meet You
lessons.description: Greet people, ask how they are and use the verb "съм" (to be).

multiple_choice.name: Match the first phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I am Maria
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Аз съм Мария." means "I am Maria." Съм is the "I" form of the verb "to be".

true_false.name: True or false: Kak ste
true_false.sentence: "Как сте?" is the polite way to ask a stranger "How are you?"
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Сте" is the plural form, which Bulgarian also uses to be polite. With a friend you say "Как си?".

fill_in_the_blank.name: We are from Plovdiv
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ние сме от Пловдив." means "We are from Plovdiv." Сме goes with "ние" (we).

true_false.name: True or false: Te
true_false.sentence: "Те" means "you" when you talk to several people.
true_false.explanation: "Те" means "they". When you talk to several people, "you" is "вие".

multiple_choice.name: Match the pronouns
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English pronoun to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: They are students
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Те са студенти." means "They are students." Са goes with "те" (they).

lessons.name: Who Are You?
lessons.description: Say where you are from and what you do, with masculine and feminine nouns for people.

multiple_choice.name: Match the people
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Jessica from London
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Джесика е англичанка от Лондон." means "Jessica is an Englishwoman from London." Jessica is a woman, so the feminine form is needed.

true_false.name: True or false: the -ка ending
true_false.sentence: Many Bulgarian words for women end in -ка, like "лекарка" (female doctor).
true_false.explanation: Correct. Adding -ка to a masculine noun often gives the feminine one: лекар, лекарка; учител, учителка.

fill_in_the_blank.name: He is a doctor
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той е __ и работи в болница.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той е лекар и работи в болница." means "He is a doctor and works in a hospital." Той (he) takes the masculine form.

true_false.name: True or false: Na kolko godini si
true_false.sentence: "На колко години си?" asks "Where are you from?"
true_false.explanation: "На колко години си?" asks "How old are you?". "Where are you from?" is "Откъде си?".

multiple_choice.name: Match the countries
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each country to its Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Twenty years old
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Аз съм на двадесет __ и живея в Русе.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Аз съм на двадесет години и живея в Русе." means "I am twenty years old and I live in Ruse." Age is given with "на ... години".

lessons.name: My Family
lessons.description: Name your relatives and talk about what you have with "имам" and "има".

multiple_choice.name: Match the family
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each family member to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: One brother and one sister
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Аз __ един брат и една сестра.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Аз имам един брат и една сестра." means "I have one brother and one sister."

true_false.name: True or false: Nyamam
true_false.sentence: The opposite of "имам" (I have) is "нямам" (I do not have).
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarian never says "не имам". The negative is one word: нямам, нямаш, няма.

fill_in_the_blank.name: This is my sister
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Това е моята сестра." means "This is my sister." Сестра is feminine, so "my" is моята. You can also say "сестра ми".

true_false.name: True or false: Ima
true_false.sentence: "В стаята има котка." means "There is a cat in the room."
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Има" means "there is" or "there are". Its negative is "няма".

multiple_choice.name: Match more family
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each family word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two sisters
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Нямам брат, но имам две сестри." means "I do not have a brother, but I have two sisters."

lessons.name: Numbers and My Day
lessons.description: Count to twenty, name the days of the week and describe your day in the present tense.

multiple_choice.name: Match the weekdays
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each day of the week to its Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I get up at eight
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Всеки ден аз __ в осем часа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Всеки ден аз ставам в осем часа." means "Every day I get up at eight o'clock."

true_false.name: True or false: Dvanadeset
true_false.sentence: "Дванадесет" is the number 12.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Дванадесет is 12. In speech it is often shortened to "дванайсет".

fill_in_the_blank.name: We sleep until noon
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В събота ние спим до обяд." means "On Saturday we sleep until noon." Спим goes with "ние".

true_false.name: True or false: Nedelya
true_false.sentence: "Неделя" is Saturday.
true_false.explanation: "Неделя" is Sunday. Saturday is "събота".

multiple_choice.name: Match the numbers
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each number to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Monday to Friday
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Работя от понеделник до __ всяка седмица.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Работя от понеделник до петък всяка седмица." means "I work from Monday to Friday every week."

lessons.name: Our Home
lessons.description: Rooms, furniture and simple directions around the house.

multiple_choice.name: Match the home words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each part of the home to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Where the fridge is
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Хладилникът е в кухнята до печката." means "The fridge is in the kitchen next to the cooker."

true_false.name: True or false: Leglo
true_false.sentence: "Легло" (bed) is a neuter noun.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Most nouns ending in -о or -е are neuter: легло, кресло, огледало.

fill_in_the_blank.name: On the right
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Шкафът не е вляво, а __ от вратата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Шкафът не е вляво, а вдясно от вратата." means "The wardrobe is not on the left but to the right of the door."

true_false.name: True or false: Stai
true_false.sentence: The plural of "стая" (room) is "стаи".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Feminine nouns ending in -я usually change it to -и in the plural: стая, стаи.

multiple_choice.name: Match the furniture
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each piece of furniture to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A big sofa
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: В хола има голям __ и две кресла.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В хола има голям диван и две кресла." means "In the living room there is a big sofa and two armchairs." Голям is masculine, and so is диван.

lessons.name: Visiting Friends
lessons.description: Ask questions, offer drinks and use "искам" (to want) as a guest or host.

multiple_choice.name: Match the question words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English question word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Tea or coffee
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Какво __ да пиеш, чай или кафе?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Какво искаш да пиеш, чай или кафе?" means "What do you want to drink, tea or coffee?" The verb matches "ти" (you), which is the subject of "пиеш".

true_false.name: True or false: Zapovyadaite
true_false.sentence: "Заповядайте!" can be used to invite a guest to come in.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Заповядайте!" means "Please come in" or "Here you are", depending on the moment.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Just water
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Благодаря, аз искам само вода." means "Thank you, I only want water."

true_false.name: True or false: Nie iskat
true_false.sentence: The "we" form of "искам" is "ние искат".
true_false.explanation: The "we" form is "ние искаме". "Искат" goes with "те" (they).

multiple_choice.name: Match food and drink
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: What is your name
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Как се казваш?" means "What is your name?", literally "How are you called?".

lessons.name: At Work
lessons.description: Jobs, simple commands and the words "който" and "която" (who).

multiple_choice.name: Match the jobs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each job to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Close the door
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Моля, затвори вратата!" means "Please close the door!" Затвори is the command form.

true_false.name: True or false: Koyto
true_false.sentence: In "Колегата, който работи с мен, е от Варна", the word "който" means "who".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Който" is "who" for a man. The sentence means "The colleague who works with me is from Varna."

fill_in_the_blank.name: The woman who works here
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Жената, __ работи тук, е моя колежка.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Жената, която работи тук, е моя колежка." means "The woman who works here is my colleague." Жена is feminine, so "who" is която.

true_false.name: True or false: Chakai
true_false.sentence: The command "Чакай!" (wait!) is polite enough for your boss.
true_false.explanation: "Чакай!" is informal. To your boss say "Изчакайте, моля."

multiple_choice.name: Match the workplaces
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each workplace to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The teacher works at a school
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Учителят работи в училище до парка." means "The teacher works at a school next to the park."

lessons.name: Our Planet
lessons.description: The sky, the Earth and comparing things with "по-" (more) and "най-" (most).

multiple_choice.name: Match the sky words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Bigger than the Moon
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Слънцето е по-голямо от Луната." means "The Sun is bigger than the Moon." Use по- with "от" (than).

true_false.name: True or false: Nai-visokiyat
true_false.sentence: "Най-високият" means "the tallest" or "the highest".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Най- makes the superlative: висок (tall), по-висок (taller), най-висок (tallest).

fill_in_the_blank.name: Musala
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Мусала е __ връх на Балканския полуостров.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Мусала е най-високият връх на Балканския полуостров." means "Musala is the highest peak in the Balkan Peninsula."

true_false.name: True or false: Po-malko
true_false.sentence: "По-малко" means "the most".
true_false.explanation: "По-малко" means "less". "The most" is "най-много".

multiple_choice.name: Match the opposites
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English adjective to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Smaller than the Earth
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Луната е по-малка от Земята." means "The Moon is smaller than the Earth." Луна is feminine, so the adjective ends in -а.

lessons.name: What Time Is It?
lessons.description: Tell the time, talk about today and tomorrow, and say what you must do with "трябва".

multiple_choice.name: Match the time words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Half past three
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сега е три часа и половина." means "It is half past three." After a number, час becomes часа.

true_false.name: True or false: Vreme
true_false.sentence: The Bulgarian word "време" can mean both "time" and "weather".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Нямам време" is "I have no time", and "Какво е времето?" is "What is the weather like?".

fill_in_the_blank.name: I must get up early
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Утре трябва да ставам рано." means "Tomorrow I must get up early." Трябва stays the same for every person.

true_false.name: True or false: Studeno
true_false.sentence: "Днес е студено." means "It is hot today."
true_false.explanation: "Студено" means "cold". "It is hot" is "Горещо е".

multiple_choice.name: Match the parts of the day
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each part of the day to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: From nine to six
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Магазинът работи __ девет до шест часа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Магазинът работи от девет до шест часа." means "The shop is open from nine to six." От ... до ... means "from ... to ...".

lessons.name: Seasons and Holidays
lessons.description: Seasons, months and the first Bulgarian holidays, with "през" (during) and "без" (without).

multiple_choice.name: Match the seasons
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In winter
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "През зимата често вали сняг." means "In winter it often snows." През means "during".

true_false.name: True or false: Martenitsa
true_false.sentence: On 1 March Bulgarians give each other martenitsi, small red and white decorations.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The martenitsa (мартеница) is a red and white token of health, given on 1 March for Баба Марта.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Coffee without sugar
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Пия кафе без захар." means "I drink coffee without sugar."

true_false.name: True or false: Velikden
true_false.sentence: Christmas Eve in Bulgarian is called "Великден".
true_false.explanation: "Великден" is Easter. Christmas Eve is "Бъдни вечер", and Christmas is "Коледа".

multiple_choice.name: Match the months
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each month to its Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: On the fifth of April
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Рожденият ми ден е __ пети април.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Рожденият ми ден е на пети април." means "My birthday is on the fifth of April." An exact date takes на; a whole month takes през.
